cuts.title: Ludwig Calls It 'Our Season' Then Watches The Fight
cuts.retelling: Ludwig nervously says one League of Legends fight is 'our season', goes wild when his team wins it with an Ace, and minutes later celebrates their 3-0 reverse sweep.

cuts.label: pokimane@vod2874504112/pokimane-pokimane-says-2026w42
cuts.title: Pokimane finds a suspicious user in her chat
cuts.hook: Pokimane's mod view flags a suspicious user
cuts.retelling: Pokimane sees a chatter flagged as a suspicious user who was banned in another channel nine months ago, asks what he did, and then admits that in her chat all he ever said was hello.

cuts.label: scout:burn+pengwin/burn-pengwin-approach-baitline-2026w42
cuts.title: Why did Pengwin get cornered in a hot tub?
cuts.hook: Pengwin gets ambushed in his hot tub
cuts.retelling: A streamer in a hot tub is baffled when a camera crew walks up to him, and it turns out they are a staged sting crew sent to catch a weeb.

cuts.label: nmplol@vod2878373112/nmplol-carmine-charact-2026w38
cuts.title: Jason says he'd never rob an ATM... then calls her back
cuts.hook: Jason says no to robbing an ATM...
cuts.retelling: A roleplaying armored-truck guard turns down a coworker's offer to rob an ATM, then has her called back out of curiosity, and ends up agreeing because the pay is bad.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2898319844/kaicenat-camera-cenat-2026w41
cuts.title: Kai Cenat promised not to scream in Outlast
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat promises to be the first person to beat Outlast without screaming, then the game starts, he panics, says 'I'm not doing this' over and over, and quits to the pause menu begging to come back.

cuts.label: vedal987@vod2898864607/vedal987-avatar-desert-2026w42
cuts.title: Neuro-sama screams at a truck, then says she's a really good driver
cuts.retelling: An AI VTuber sees a huge truck, panics, yells that she has a child in the car and screams as she heads for a rock wall, then claims she's a really good driver.

cuts.label: scout:ludwig/ludwig-clas-ludwig-2026w29

cuts.hook: "Not noteworthy to be trans and playing
cuts.retelling: Ludwig's class roasts a student's first video, 'I Play Fortnite with a Transgender', and the student admits the girl in it only joked about being trans and he clickbaited it.

cuts.label: stableronaldo@vod2894305475/stableronaldo-actually-minecraft-2026w41

cuts.retelling: A Minecraft streamer panics over his stolen boat, then a friend named JC keeps messing with him until he dies and the world resets, and he says JC is trolling on purpose.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2896498763/kaicenat-about-america-2026w41
cuts.title: Kai Cenat: 'Oh yeah, I'm banned'
cuts.hook: Kai shuts off a stream, then learns
cuts.retelling: Kai yells for another streamer's stream to be cut off, then minutes later, dressed in costume, learns he's been banned, wonders why his own stream ended, and finds out he's banned from Walmart.

cuts.hook: Ron ruined Jasontheween's new car intro
cuts.retelling: Jasontheween's new-car drone intro gets spoiled by Ron, who then calls Kai Cenat's stream, calls him fat, and gets a bet that Kai will get a six-pack before him.

cuts.label: jasontheween@vod2874179448/jasontheween-about-account-2026w38
